text:
Asking rents in Stuttgart stand at a median of 15.98 €/m² (2026-06), up 0.1% on the year and +15.3% over five years. That ranks Stuttgart #3 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 54% above the 2022 average contract rent of 10.39 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 959 € a month in cold rent, 18.3% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 29 days and 23% are gone within a week; with 1.8% market-active vacancy and -0.1% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 16.70 €/m² (+4.5%), with an 80% range of 16.35 to 17.22 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
